allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Asterix and Obelix have been given a tough mission: Transform the chief's lazy nephew Justforkix into a warrior. When the Vikings abduct him and bring him back to their homeland, Asterix and Obelix must travel to Norway to rescue Justforkix.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: When fierce Vikings snatch the untested nephew away to their homeland, can Asterix and Obelix reach him before his lack of warrior skills seals his fate?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Tasked with turning the chief's pampered nephew Justforkix into a warrior, Asterix and Obelix face an unexpected crisis when visiting Vikings kidnap the boy, forcing a perilous rescue expedition north to Norway.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Brisk and lighthearted; an easy, upbeat animated rescue adventure built for family viewing with friends.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: This energetic 78-minute animated romp pairs brisk comedy with classic buddy dynamics, offering vibrant adventure that moves swiftly from Gaulish antics to Nordic shores.
